decisions.decision: Notification payload grammar is fixed at {kind}:{id} — literally due:{vehicleId} and odo:{vehicleId}. due: routes to /, odo: routes to /?sheet=odo. /vehicle/:id is never added to the route table.
decisions.rationale: One-way door: a payload is serialised into the OS scheduled-notification store and handed back to whatever build is installed when it fires, up to 120 days later. Confirmed by the user at 04-01 Task 1's blocking checkpoint; matches P4-D-01/P4-D-02 and the source doc's SS10.7 verbatim. The versioned and json alternatives were presented and declined.

decisions.decision: Executor dispatch prompts embed the large GSD reference docs as absolute-path Read-tool instructions rather than inlining their full text.
decisions.rationale: execute-phase.md asks the orchestrator to inline ~103 KB of reference material verbatim into every executor prompt. @-includes do not expand inside an Agent() prompt (#3324), but an explicit Read-tool instruction does, and it costs ~26K output tokens less per dispatch. The gsd-executor agent definition already @-references checkpoints.md and summary.md, so those arrive twice over.
